recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up in core FHIR is needed for FHIR-8019 unless a human decides to regenerate or curate historical release snapshots for another reason; they already contain the corrected wording.
issue_request: FHIR-8019 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy technical correction asking to change the MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction.maxDosePerPeriod example from "2 tablets ever 4 hours to a maximum of 8/day" to "2 tablets every 4 hours to a maximum of 8/day".
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn 6228, and Git commit cd2ba64c4215bd09a4574ab74077fc2726f2eb63 is that application commit. It explicitly changed source/medicationprescription/medicationprescription-spreadsheet.xml from "ever" to "every" in the maxDosePerPeriod comments, alongside the separate FHIR-6969 typo fix.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is no longer an active current-build resource; source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest=MedicationRequest in active resources and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. The current source and checked-in release-history snapshots do not contain the misspelled "2 tablets ever 4 hours" text. The corrected example text remains only in historical release snapshots, while the active current source no longer carries that exact maxDosePerPeriod comment.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the requested typo correction was already applied to the historical MedicationPrescription source and the current build has no remaining misspelled current source location to fix.

related_jiras.note: The same svn/Git application commit corrected a separate MedicationPrescription typo, but this reconciliation intentionally audits only FHIR-8019.
